title: Carrera GT in the Rain on a Mountain Road
title_tail: Lo-Fi & Rain for Sleep, Work & Focus
label: RAINY DRIVES
description:
Rainy Drives: a british racing green Porsche Carrera GT in the rain on a mountain road, rain falling over the pines and a lake below. 8 hours of slow, original lo-fi with the weather soft underneath, for working, studying, relaxing or drifting off to sleep.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original to this channel.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
